label: LANTIME M300 NTP time server
description: 1U rackmount Stratum-1 NTP server that disciplines its clock from a built-in GPS/GLONASS, DCF77, MSF, WWVB or IRIG reference receiver, or from up to seven upstream NTP servers in Stratum-2 mode, and answers NTP/SNTP for the LAN. Two 10/100 RJ45 ports are fitted as standard and the chassis can take up to six, including 1GbE or fibre modules; PPS, 10 MHz and IRIG outputs are BNC and the two RS-232 management ports are D-Sub, so neither is a network port.
notes: Meinberg datasheet: 'Standard: 2 x 10/100 MBit with RJ45 connector'; options add 2 or 4 more 10/100 ports, or 1x 10/100 + 1x/3x 10/100/1000 (1GE/3GE). Max 6 Ethernet ports total. Discontinued and replaced by LANTIME M320, which is the same 2x 10/100 chassis. Management is Web/SSH/Telnet/SNMPv1-3, all over eth0/eth1.
